title: jkit: how to get a JDK, Maven, Gradle or sbt
text: jkit now ships a Windows MSI, so inicia installs it like the other Vitrina apps. inicia doesn't install JDKs, Maven, Gradle or sbt itself: install jkit, then run jkit install jdk@21 (or maven, gradle, sbt) to get them, from 20+ JDK vendors, each download checked. "All Vitrina apps" includes it.

title: Go, Rust and a C/C++ compiler
text: Go, Rust (through rustup, with the stable toolchain) and Microsoft's Visual Studio Build Tools, which Rust needs to link programs on Windows, so picking Rust brings them along. Python, Node.js and the .NET SDK move to the new Programming category.

title: WinSCP, and picking whole groups
text: WinSCP joins the catalog. Pick everything at once, a whole category, or every Vitrina app, and the download keeps a short name: inicia_all.exe, inicia_cat-media.exe, inicia_suite-vitrina.exe. FileZilla isn't here: its download links expire and are only handed to web browsers. Neither is Zenmap: only the paid Nmap OEM installer runs silently.

title: 15 more apps, from Chrome to VirtualBox
text: Browsers, developer tools, runtimes, office and media apps. VirtualBox now brings the Visual C++ runtime it needs with it, and Docker Desktop's card says what installing it accepts. WhatsApp and ChatGPT aren't here: they're only published through the Microsoft Store, with no installer to download and check. Neither is Claude Desktop: its download only answers web browsers.

title: The Vitrina apps
text: Six apps from the Vitrina collection, installed from their Windows MSI releases.

title: inicia starts
text: The first catalog: five apps, each download checked against its publisher's SHA-256 or code signature before it runs.
